texts:
Friday's notes, team by team: a season-ending knee in Chicago, Washington's new pecking order and the pickups the usage backs.

Cole Kmet

Chig Okonkwo

Germie Bernard
#DaBears #RaiseHail #HereWeGo

Cole Kmet was carted off in Thursday's win over NE with a right knee injury Ian Rapoport reports is likely season-ending. TE47 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add.

Colston Loveland has the tight end routes to himself now. TE4 rest of season for me.
#DaBears #NEPats

Chig Okonkwo ran a route on over 80 percent of the dropbacks at SF and caught all 7 targets for 69, and Terry McLaurin is out for the season.

TE19 rest of season for me. Stash him through the bye, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Antonio Williams ran a route on 73 to 76 percent of the dropbacks in Weeks 4 to 6. WR66 rest of season for me. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.

Rachaad White played about 70 percent of the snaps at SF. RB38 rest of season for me. Stash him, 2 to 4 percent.
#RaiseHail #FTTB

Jacory Croskey-Merritt is on IR with the groin for at least four games, about Weeks 8 to 11 after the bye.

RB43 rest of season for me. Hold him in an IR spot; with none open, drop him for any add.
#RaiseHail

Seattle put Elijah Arroyo on IR Thursday, and shoulder surgery ends his season, per ESPN's Adam Schefter. Drop him for any add.

AJ Barner played 93 percent of the snaps after Arroyo got hurt. Outside my top 12 vs KC and TE25 rest of season; sit him.
#Seahawks #ChiefsKingdom

Germie Bernard ran a route on every dropback and drew 12 targets in Week 6, with Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. on IR.

WR22 for me vs NO in Paris this week, a WR2.
#HereWeGo #Saints

Mike Washington Jr. took half the early downs in Week 6, a season-high 35 percent of the snaps, while Ashton Jeanty fell to 58 percent.

RB39 for me vs LAR, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#RaiderNation #RamsHouse

Terrance Ferguson is expected to stay on IR past his Week 8 eligibility with the ankle, per ESPN's Adam Schefter.

TE22 rest of season for me, and no FAAB yet. Monitor his practice window, Week 8 or later.
#RamsHouse

J.J. McCarthy starts at HOU over Jameis Winston. Most of his 243 yards vs NO came down big. QB26 for me; monitor his first start before you add him in superflex.

Cam Skattebo played 6 snaps with no touches in Week 6. RB36 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him.
#NYGiants #HTownMade

Dalton Schultz was limited Thursday with the quad, and two receivers join the rotation. TE18 for me vs NYG, outside my top 12; sit him.

Marvin Harrison Jr. ran a route on 26 percent of the dropbacks in his part-time debut. WR49 for me, a dart throw.
#HTownMade #NYGiants

Ja'Kobi Lane ran a route on 58 percent of the dropbacks and drew 5 targets in his first game off IR.

WR48 for me vs CIN, a low-end flex play to a dart throw. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#RavensFlock #WhoDey

Carnell Tate drew 32 percent of Tennessee's targets at IND and 70 of Cam Ward's 102 passing yards.

WR25 for me vs CLE, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play, and WR29 rest of season.
#TitanUp #DawgPound

Bryce Young practiced in full Thursday with the knee, and he has 11 touchdown passes to 1 interception through five games.

QB10 for me vs TB this week.
#KeepPounding #GoBucs

Kyler Murray comes off the bye vs IND with Colts cornerback Sauce Gardner out. QB11 for me, a borderline start this week.

Jauan Jennings has 2 catches for 9 yards in four games. WR73 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add.
#Skol #ForTheShoe

Brevyn Spann-Ford started over Jake Ferguson in Week 6, and Ferguson ran a route on about half the dropbacks and caught 2 for 13.

TE24 for me at PHI Monday, outside my top 12; sit him.
#DallasCowboys #FlyEaglesFly

Dameon Pierce played 61 of 64 snaps with Saquon Barkley out, and Philadelphia waived Jaydon Blue, so Pierce is the only backup.

RB33 for me this week, a low-end RB3; sit him and hold him as the handcuff.
#FlyEaglesFly

Jonah Coleman practiced after Denver opened his IR window, and he is questionable at ARI. RB49 rest of season for me. Stash him, 2 to 4 percent of FAAB.

J.K. Dobbins keeps the early downs until Coleman is active. RB23 for me, an RB2.
#BroncosCountry #BirdGang

Brian Thomas Jr. was benched in the second half vs HOU, and Liam Coen calls him week to week through the bye.

WR49 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share in Week 8 before you sell.
#DUUUVAL #HTownMade

Every note from today is on the Pass, and Sunday's inactives and pivots start at 11:30 AM ET.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the weekend's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
